description: Active Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Use this as the reviewed candidate recipe.
goal: Test whether a clean Enyo-owned initialization learns once LR is high enough, before spending a full training run.

success_condition: gradient norms are nonzero for sparse input, L1, L2, and output layers
exported model.nn is non-empty and can be evaluated by static validation
next_after_success: run a larger scratch schedule on the same labeled source
compare against an identical current-reference-initialized control
only then consider failure-suite and SPRT gates
